svg.desc: A dark banner with an animated flow-field particle background. On the left, the wordmark hero-readme and a tagline; on the right, a stylized README document whose top hero band shimmers — illustrating an animated hero placed at the top of a README.

g.text: authentic, animated hero images for your README
no generic AI art — a hero that shows what your project actually is
